name: twilio
label: Twilio
description: Cloud communications platform for building SMS, Voice & Messaging applications

accountSid.label: Account SID
accountSid.description: Starts with AC. Shown under Account Info in the Twilio Console.

authToken.label: Auth Token
authToken.description: Click Show under Account Info in the Twilio Console to reveal it.

phone_number_lookup.label: Phone Number Lookup
phone_number_lookup.description: Look up the carrier and line type (mobile, landline) of a number.

phone_number.label: Phone Number
phone_number.description: Phone number with country code, starting with +.

get_message.label: Get Message
get_message.description: Get the status and details of a sent or received message.

message_sid.label: Message SID
message_sid.description: Starts with SM or MM. Shown in the Send SMS output and Twilio logs.
